correctness.rationale: For h>=3,d>=1,gcd(a,d)=1, B=h²-h+1, T=(h-1)², a=qB+s with q>=h−1, every element has residue indexed M=v+Bu and minimal cost W(M)=h² floor(M/B)+h(M mod B). Replacing M by M+a increases W because W(M+a)-W(M)=h(a-T*K), K<=q+1, and a−T(q+1)>=q*h+s−T>0 in stated range. Thus Apéry_{dr mod a}=aW(r)+dr, r=0..a−1. Summing complete B-blocks gives the stated genus; max Apéry lies at full-block terminal qB−1 or residual terminal a−1, giving R,U, U−R=ds−ah(T−s). The two terminal elements are maximal and incomparable in semigroup preorder by explicit residue-minimum inequalities; the PF set is {R}, s=0, or {R,U}, s>0, giving type and symmetry. Equality U=R is excluded since gcd(a,d)=1, s in (0,B), and a> s. Independent priority-queue residue shortest paths for 215 actual h,a,d parameter triples recomputed all Apéry values, genus and pseudo-Frobenius sets without using greedy construction; finite checks support the unlimited proof.
